title: Ankhorage Neptune Graph Database
summary: Records the repository boundary reserved for an Amazon Neptune graph database adapter.
purpose: Keep ownership of a future Neptune provider adapter separate from provider-neutral graph contracts and application code.
responsibilities: Own the repository-level boundary for an Amazon Neptune graph adapter when one is implemented.
boundaries: Does not currently contain a Neptune adapter, package, or deployment configuration.
Does not own provider-neutral graph contracts or generic graph algorithms.
audience: Maintainers evaluating or implementing an Amazon Neptune persistence adapter.

architecture.role: Non-source provider-adapter repository with no runtime implementation on the current default branch.
invariants: Future Neptune-specific code must remain at an adapter boundary behind a published provider-neutral graph port.

limitations: The current default branch contains licensing and repository metadata only; no Neptune capability is shipped.
